newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi army says three days of fighting ends.
newsitem.headline: Burundi army says three days of fighting ends.

text.p: Burundi's Tutsi-dominated army said on Friday its soldiers killed more than 100 guerrillas and drove back rebels from hills overlooking the capital in three days of fighting.
Army spokesman Lieutenant-Colonel Longin Minani said three soldiers were killed and one wounded before heavy overnight rain brought an end to fighting on the eastern approaches to Bujumbura.

"The pursuit of the rebels is over and it was a successful operation. There were over 100 terrorists killed. We don't know where they are now, but wherever they go we will pursue them," he told Reuters.

Burundi's main Hutu rebel group, the National Council for the Defence of Democracy, said its armed wing had launched attacks on Bujumbura since Tuesday in a show of strength after a month of regional sanctions on the land-locked country.
